title: The Pink Cat Halloween Costume
intro: The cat costume, done warm enough for actual trick or treating. A pink puff sleeve sweater dress does the heavy lifting, white thigh high socks and bow ballet flats keep it sweet, and the glitter cat ears tell everyone what you are in one glance. A fluffy heart bag on a gold chain and gold heart earrings finish it without tipping into costume shop. The dress keeps working long after the candy is gone: tights, boots and a coat, and it is a December outfit.
